name: sugarcraft/sugar-mouse
description: Mouse support for terminal UIs: sentinel-tagged Mark/Scan/Get hit-testing primitives (ZoneClickTracker press/release dedup, Selection) plus the bubblezone-style Zones Manager layer with hover, drag, and multi-click trackers — both layers in one package.

suggest.ext-intl: UAX #29 grapheme clustering in Scan::parse() — without it, ZWJ emoji, regional-indicator flags and combining runs split per lead byte and zone bounding-box columns can shift host-to-host
